name: Grilled Turmeric Chicken with Minty Cucumber-Avocado Salad
instructions: In a large bowl, combine and mix together the yogurt, lemon juice, turmeric, cumin, salt, and pepper. Transfer half of the yogurt mixture to another large bowl.
Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board; cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets.
Place the chicken in one of the bowls and coat in the yogurt mixture; set aside for 15 minutes.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and discard the cucumber ends; small dice the cucumbers and add to the other bowl of yogurt.
Halve and pit the avocados; scoop out the flesh and discard the skins. Small dice the flesh and add to the bowl.
Peel and mince the shallots; add to the bowl.
Heat a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan/skillet heats up, pick the mint leaves off the stems; discard the stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl and toss the salad until well combined.
Transfer the chicken to a plate, wiping off excess marinade.
Coat the grill pan or skillet with coconut oil.
Place the chicken in the grill pan or skillet; cook until cooked through and golden brown, 3 to 4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Divide the chicken and cucumber-avocado salad between four plates (or two plates and two lunch containers). Enjoy!
author: Mealime
